about: Spectrum Brands Holdings, Inc. operates as a branded consumer products and home essentials company in North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, and the Asia-Pacific regions. The company offers rawhide and rawhide free chews and treats, dog and cat clean-up, training, health and grooming, and small animal food and care products; wet and dry pet food; consumer and commercial aquarium kits, stand-alone tanks, filtration systems, and heaters and pumps; and aquatics consumables, including fish food, water management, and care. It also provides spider and scorpion killers, ant and roach killers, flying insect killers, insect foggers, wasp and hornet killers, and bedbug, and flea and tick control products; weed control solutions and insect and animal repellents comprising aerosols, granules, and ready-to-use spray or hose-and-ready-to-sprays; aerosols, lotions, pump sprays, and wipes; yard sprays and citronella candles; and household surface cleaning, maintenance, and restoration products, including bottled liquids, and mops. In addition, the company small kitchen appliances, such as toaster ovens, coffeemakers, slow cookers, air fryers, blenders, hand mixers, grills, food processors, juicers, toasters, irons, kettles, and bread makers, cookware, and cookbooks; and hair dryers, flat irons and straighteners, rotary and foil electric shavers, personal groomers, mustache and beard trimmers, body groomers, nose and ear trimmers, women's shavers, and haircut kits. It sells its products under the Good'n'Fun, Good Boy, DreamBone, Nature's Miracle, SmartBones, FURminator, Wild HarvestTM, 8IN1, Dingo, Better Belly, Meowee!, Eukanuba, IAMS, Tetra, Marineland, GloFish, Instant Ocean, OmegaSea, Hot Shot, Black Flag, Spectracide, Liquid Fence, Garden Safe, Cutter, and Remington brands through brick-and-mortar retail channels, e-commerce channels, wholesalers, and distributors. Spectrum Brands Holdings, Inc. was founded in 1906 and is based in Middleton, Wisconsin.
